findings.statement: Convergence rank 1 (score 4.5197, 5 streams). Open Targets association score 0.3088, rank 79 of 1998. Cell membrane (microvillus membrane) protein, so antibody-accessible. Drugs: GIRENTUXIMAB PHASE_3, IODINE I 124 GIRENTUXIMAB PHASE_2, SULTHIAME PHASE_4, ETHOXZOLAMIDE WITHDRAWAL. Tumour-up in TCGA (log2FC 9.712). DepMap: mean effect in ccRCC lines 0.051, no dependency, so strong biomarker/antibody-targeting case (imaging or ADC), not a functional dependency.

Convergence rank 3 (score 4.2143, 4 streams). Open Targets association score 0.0572. Plasma membrane ligand of CD27 (antibody-tractable). Drugs: CUSATUZUMAB PHASE_2, VORSETUZUMAB MAFODOTIN PHASE_1, VORSETUZUMAB PHASE_1, MDX-1411 PHASE_1. Tumour-up in TCGA (log2FC 7.09). Untested-in-ccRCC-approval but tractable; DepMap mean effect 0.251 (no dependency), so the case rests on a tumour-selective surface antigen (ADC/CAR-T), not on dependency.

Convergence rank 7 (score 3.9643). Open Targets association score 0.0598 (literature-driven). Tumour-up in TCGA (log2FC 4.685), purity-robust; higher expression associates with worse survival (Cox log HR 0.301). No drugs recorded; DepMap mean effect 0.316 (no dependency). Candidate prognostic/diagnostic biomarker, weak target case.

Convergence rank 5 (score 4.1052). Open Targets association score 0.4049 (genetic association 0.519). Cell membrane/caveola receptor. Tumour-up in TCGA (log2FC 3.989). No drugs in Open Targets; DepMap mean effect 0.002 (no dependency). Tractable-but-untested surface candidate; druggability without dependency is a weaker target case.

Convergence rank 2 (score 4.2206). Open Targets association score 0.0701. Down in tumour (TCGA log2FC -4.741), higher expression associated with better survival (Cox log HR -0.358). No drugs; DepMap mean effect 0.156 (no dependency). Loss-of-expression (proximal tubule identity) biomarker, not a target.

Convergence rank 4 (score 4.1667). Open Targets association score 0.0662. Down in tumour (TCGA log2FC -6.154), better survival with higher expression (Cox log HR -0.402). Drugs: PROBENECID PHASE_4, PRATOSARTAN PHASE_3 (transporter substrates/inhibitors, not ccRCC-directed). DepMap mean effect -0.019 (no dependency). Down-regulation biomarker only.

Convergence rank 6 (score 4.0695). Open Targets association score 0.4532 (genetic association 0.7338). Down in tumour (TCGA log2FC -3.721). No drugs; DepMap mean effect 0.143 (no dependency). Association-driven down-regulated biomarker candidate.

Established ccRCC target (HIF-2 alpha). Open Targets association score 0.4871. Drug: BELZUTIFAN APPROVAL. Tractability: small molecule (approved drug, high-quality ligand). DepMap: ccRCC mean effect -0.143 vs other 0.157, selectivity 0.3, 0.208 of ccRCC lines dependent, not common essential (padj 0.061), i.e. modest selective dependency.

Established ccRCC target. Open Targets association score 0.525. Many inhibitors, e.g. RIDAFOROLIMUS APPROVAL, GEDATOLISIB PHASE_3, DACTOLISIB PHASE_3. DepMap: ccRCC mean effect -1.52, all ccRCC lines dependent (1.0) but common essential (toxicity risk), selectivity 0.354. Recurrently mutated in ccRCC: 37 of 511 patients (freq 0.072, padj 5.7e-14).

Established ccRCC target (VEGFR2). Open Targets association score 0.4566. Approved drugs include PAZOPANIB HYDROCHLORIDE APPROVAL, AXITINIB APPROVAL, TIVOZANIB APPROVAL, CABOZANTINIB S-MALATE APPROVAL, RAMUCIRUMAB APPROVAL. Tractability: antibody and small molecule. Acts on tumour vasculature; DepMap shows no ccRCC tumour-cell dependency (mean effect 0.079, selectivity -0.027), consistent with a microenvironment/angiogenesis mechanism.
Top Open Targets associated gene (score 0.6466). Somatic mutation in 247 of 511 tumours (freq 0.483, padj 0.0, recurrent), the defining driver upstream of HIF-2 alpha/CA9 induction.
Open Targets association score 0.6348 (second). Recurrent driver: 185 of 511 tumours (freq 0.362, padj 4.59e-239). Tumour suppressor, association/driver only with no direct drug.

caveats: Convergence-ranking top genes (CA9, CD70, NNMT, SCARB1) show no DepMap dependency in ccRCC lines; their case is surface-antigen/biomarker, not functional dependency.
Several metabolic/transporter genes (ALDOB, SLC22A8, PIGR) are down-regulated tissue-identity markers; tumour-purity effects may contribute.
Only convergence_ranking top 12 were returned inline, so lower-ranked genes were not reviewed; STRING not queried.
Drug stages reported as returned by Open Targets; drugs are not necessarily ccRCC-indicated.
KDR, CA9 and SCARB1 DepMap records have null evidence ids so their DepMap values are stated without citation weight.
